name: Coirpre
text: Coirpre is another spelling of Cairbre, an early Irish name carried by kings, warriors, and poets. MacKillop treats Coirpre as a cross-reference to his entry on Cairbre.

okr.objective: Coirpre is a variant spelling of the name Cairbre.
key_results: MacKillop points Coirpre readers to the Cairbre entry.
Cairbre belongs to many early Irish kings, warriors, and poets.
